subject: Targets: Sonnet 4.6 + an OpenAI model; 'backend:model' specs in get_llm (Nathan)
body: Nathan decided the model inside the environment is BOTH claude-sonnet-4-6 (thinking on) and an OpenAI model (id not chosen yet). llm.get_llm now accepts a 'backend:model' spec for any role, overriding --llm for that role: --target anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6+thinking --heldout-target openai:<model>+thinking (backends: offline, anthropic, openai, openai-compat, claude-cli). No cli.py change needed. New llm.OpenAIResponsesLLM (Responses API, stdlib HTTP, OPENAI_API_KEY; refuses to start unless the model's price is known via OPENAI_PRICE_PER_MTOK='in,out'). Both vendors return reasoning SUMMARIES, not raw CoT. API backends (anthropic, openai) now report list-price cost, so Budget.max_cost_usd applies to them too (before, only claude-cli counted). Nothing has been run against a real API. C2 (Abhi): please put both targets in configs/models.json; which one is dev and which is held-out is still open.
